status: Locked after implementation and full-suite verification, before TAPIP3D inference or trajectory scoring.
claim_boundary: One-case post-open observation-competence control on the previously examined single_lift_cloth source interaction. Frame-zero manual identity coordinates are supplied as an association oracle. The result may reject TAPIP3D as a PhysTwin sparse-identity feeder or authorize an automatic frame-zero graph-query source study. It cannot establish forecasting performance, transfer, calibration, state of the art, or permission to inspect any fresh or held-v8 target.
question: Does official TAPIP3D recover persistent world-space material identities from a causal RGB-D prefix with materially broader and more accurate support than the frozen strict-three-view CoTracker3 comparator?
case_selection: Already-open source case selected before TAPIP3D inference because all nine released manual identities are visible in camera 0 at frame zero and agree with sensor depth to within 1 mm.

cotracker3_comparator.description: Frozen nearest-node frame-zero association followed by strict-three-view, gauge-anchored CoTracker3 displacement, re-anchored to the identical nine query coordinates.

metrics.support_denominator: finite released manual identity-frame pairs in frames [0, 121)
metrics.displacement_rmse: Euclidean RMSE of tracker displacement relative to each tracker's frame-zero coordinate against released manual displacement.
metrics.shared_support_comparison: TAPIP3D and CoTracker3 are compared only on identity-frame pairs valid for both, preventing different support from creating the relative accuracy result.
metrics.position_rmse: Euclidean world-position RMSE on each method's valid identity-frame pairs.
metrics.frame_zero_anchor_rmse: Euclidean RMSE between predicted and supplied frame-zero query coordinates.
metrics.late_third: Frames [80, 121), with start computed as floor(2 * 121 / 3).
metrics.common_translation_diagnostic: Per-frame mean displacement error and residual RMSE after removing that mean; diagnostic only and not a gate.

competence_gate.pass_action: Freeze this result and design an automatic frame-zero graph-query study on opened source data only. Do not open a fresh target.
competence_gate.fail_action: Stop TAPIP3D as the PhysTwin sparse-identity feeder without tuning on this opened source trajectory.

technical_failure_policy.rule: Record an inference failure without scoring. Any lower-resolution or altered-memory retry requires a separately committed amendment before another model run.

forbidden: changing TAPIP3D inference settings, visibility threshold, comparator support, metric definitions, or competence thresholds after model inference
using manual identity coordinates after frame zero to generate, select, repair, or admit the prediction
calling this association-oracle source control deployable, predictive, transferable, calibrated, confirmatory, or state of the art
integrating TAPIP3D into Bayesian-PhysTwin before all competence gates pass
opening any fresh-object outcome on the authority of this one-case control
opening, inspecting, modifying, or rerunning any held-v8 target, query, score, barrier, or outcome artifact
